base.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production detailed high-quality 16-bit arcade beat-em-up background, wide 3:1 panoramic composition. A NEW closed subway track tunnel, inside the railway bore beyond a maintenance workshop. Side-on 2.5D fighting-game view, broad safe rail bed across lower quarter, TWO steel rails run horizontally left to right on wooden/concrete sleepers and dark ballast, ample flat playable space. Concrete/aged brick arched tunnel ribs, cables and pipes along rear wall, amber caged work lamps, occasional portable maintenance lights, inspection niches, signal boxes and restrained yellow safety markings. Deep industrial detail, rich metal/grime/brick materials, realistic coherent perspective. This line is CLOSED TO TRAINS: absolutely NO trains or other moving vehicles, no characters, no giant text, no HUD. Avoid a vanishing-point view looking straight down the track: this is a side-scrolling lateral cross-section of a tunnel. Put rail/ballast floor surface starting at about 75 percent image height; wall ribs behind it. Left/right edges should have similar brick/rib tones so a middle arch span can be repeated as modular tunnel architecture. Distinct from a workshop or station platform. Crisp detailed pixel-art shading consistent with Urban Fracture's maintenance reference, no blurry low-detail 8-bit replacement. Ceiling stays in upper portion. No floating signs.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for Urban Fracture. Reference is Broxton's exact established identity/style: massive muscular medium-brown man, close black hair/goatee, shoulder tattoos, ivory tank top, CHARCOAL GREY cargo pants and black boots. Create eight consistent full-body animation frames, 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, all facing RIGHT, same body proportions/pixel density and planted sole baseline, true alpha transparent background, generous separation, NO labels/text/opponent/weapons/shadows. EXACTLY TWO ARMS AND TWO LEGS in EVERY pose, no ghost limbs. This is a powerful fast OVERHEAD FORWARD THROW TO THE GROUND: row1 frame1 bent knees with hands held up ready to hoist; frame2 straightening with both open hands lifting overhead; frame3 fully raised overhead hands gripping an imagined horizontal opponent; frame4 arms begin pulling forward, elbows flexing and torso leaning forward. Row2 frame5 both arms drive forward/down forcefully together, knees braced and back bowed, clearly HURLING an opponent toward ground in front; frame6 extended downward-forward open hands at the release/follow-through, torso leans forcefully forward; frame7 withdraw hands while regaining balance; frame8 original upright fighting guard. No opponent drawn, but both hands must be anatomically plausible holding and throwing something heavy. Full feet/boots visible. Do not use an unchanged arms-up pose for the release. Preserve Broxton's exact costume and grey pants throughout. High-quality connected whole-body detailed 16-bit pixel art matching reference, no squashed/stretched anatomy, no detached arms, no multiple exposure.

car: Use case: stylized-concept. Production high-quality detailed 16-bit arcade beat-em-up background for the INSIDE of a modern subway car, a wide 3:1 panorama, side-on straight horizontal view suitable for a brawler. Believable correctly proportioned double sliding doors and windows in the rear wall, blue molded bench seats, stainless steel frames, overhead grab bars and ceiling lights, a route map securely mounted above a doorway, small advertisements firmly inside their frames, realistic floor contact and coherent perspective. Warm white lighting, clean but used transit interior, rich pixel-art metal/upholstery details. Keep adult-sized doors tall and reasonably wide, no skinny stretched architecture. Clear playable strip of grey non-slip floor across the lower quarter, doors and benches behind the lane, source floor wall-base at approximately 78 percent image height. No hero, no enemies, no passengers, no HUD, no free-floating signs, no train exterior and no deep end-on vanishing point. Match Urban Fracture's detailed sixteen-bit visual identity, no flat low-detail substitute.
frankie: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent production 16-bit game sprite strip, FOUR equal cells in one horizontal row, same fixed anatomy/pixel density and ground baseline, generous transparent margins. Reference identity is Frankie: slick black hair, BLACK SUNGLASSES, black sleeveless biker vest over grey shirt, shoulder tattoos, black gloves, dark black-grey pants with strapped knee protection and boots, chain hanging at belt (no chain being swung). Exactly TWO arms/two legs in each pose. Create four FULL-BODY GRABBED / HELD HIT REACTION poses, all facing RIGHT: (1) restrained from front, shoulders hunched, elbows bent close, hands partly open, tense pained face; (2) same front restraint, recoiling from stomach punch, torso curls forward, knees buckle slightly, visibly pained; (3) held from behind, upper arms pulled slightly back, shoulders tense, unable to use fighting guard; (4) rear-held recoil from a body hit, chest contracts and head jerks, planted feet. No hero/holder shown. No free fighting idle stance, no attack poses, no prone pose, no ghost arms, no opponent, no text/numbers/borders/background. Maintain the exact black-clothed adult biker identity and consistent body size. Crisp detailed high-quality 16-bit shaded pixel art matching reference. Genuine alpha transparent background.
scientists: Create a transparent pixel-art sprite sheet, four full-body characters in exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, generous empty gutters, no text, floor or shadows. Use the attached Urban Fracture scientist sprites as the exact character and costume reference. Top row: Ethan, white hooded protective suit, face mask, black work boots. Bottom row: Nora, blue hooded protective suit, face mask, black boots. These are restrained GRAB VICTIM poses, NOT attacks or ordinary idle: left column upper arms pinned close to ribs, bent knees, shoulders hunched and tense, hands helplessly lifted in front, torso pulled backward slightly; right column clear abdominal hit reaction while restrained, doubled forward, head winces, knees bend, arms remain trapped. No flasks, knives, rods or weapons. Exactly two arms and two legs per body. Consistent adult body proportions, identical pixel density and clothing colors to reference, detailed 16-bit arcade quality. Side three-quarter facing right. Keep comparable body size across cells, no giant heads, no disembodied parts, no extra limbs.
financial: Create a transparent sprite atlas with exactly SIX full-body poses, 2 columns by 3 rows. Reference attached Urban Fracture artwork closely for identities and costumes. Row1 Jesse: adult man, black balaclava, black hoodie, black cargo trousers/gloves/boots. Row2 Otis: obese heavy security officer, blue short-sleeve uniform, blue peaked cap, black tie, thick belt and boots, dark mustache. Row3 Leroy: middle-aged gangster, black pinstripe suit, white shirt, red tie, black fedora with red band, mustache, dress shoes. ALL characters are unarmed restrained GRAB VICTIMS. Left column: elbows pinned against ribs, hands helplessly drawn in, tense shoulders, bent knees, upper body pulled slightly backward, visibly struggling, NOT an idle fighting stance. Right column: distinct abdominal hit reaction while restrained, doubled forward and wincing, knees bend, hands drawn inward. Exactly two arms, two legs each. No guns, knives, batons, cigar, smoke, hero, floor or shadow. Retain holstered belt equipment and all costumes. Consistent body size per character across pair; Otis stays fat but no giant increase. Detailed 16-bit arcade pixel art, crisp consistent anatomy and colors, separated equal cells, generous margins, facing right three-quarter side view.
